description: Main roster table of the 陸軍現役将校同相当官実役停年名簿 大正15年9月1日調, wide-column pages: the 将官 and 佐官 sections, 5-8 officers per leaf, each section headed by rank or branch+rank (中将, 歩兵少佐) in the outer margin. Seven horizontal bands - the 大正12年 layout plus a 出身期別 row below the dates. A camera scan of the bound book.

provenance.method: Rulings detected per leaf on the camera-scan path of reading/registration.py. A leaf was admitted only if it carried all six interior rulings of this layout within 0.012: frame 20 right leaf (中将), both leaves of frame 60, the left leaves of 100 and 150 (歩兵少佐). Pooled fractions clustered at 0.015, band = cluster median; every band has support 5/5, spread <= 0.0017 except 0.1694 (0.011: frame 20 carries an extra ruling at 0.18 that chains in). Outer bands are the table frame, 0.0 and 1.0; the inner rule of the double frame (~0.006 in) falls within tolerance of them. Not admitted: frame 20 left leaf (misdetected), frame 40 (主計監 - the 各部 layout, which prints neither 列次 nor 出身期別), frame 100 right leaf (lost the 0.620 ruling), 150 right (two rulings found), 650 (no 列次 or 出身期別 rulings on either leaf - the 各部 layout), 750 (一等獸醫正, 各部; the right leaf is a blank page), 850 and 875 (index-like pages), front matter 5 and 12.
provenance.field_labels: Read from the legend column printed inside the table on frames 250 and 350: 現官ノ實役停年 / 列次 / 任官ノ年月日 / 出身期別 / 職名、命課ノ年月日 / 本邦位、勳、功、爵、學位 外國勳章 / 氏名 with 年齡 between. No legend page for the wide layout is in the sample; its seven bands hold the same content in the same order (frames 20 and 100 compared by eye). Nobody has confirmed any label on this edition.

match.note: Measured 10 Sep 2026 against every cached 1923, 1926, 1933 and 1935 leaf. Accepted: frame 20 right leaf, both leaves of 60 and 100, 150 left leaf - 7-8 of 8 bands, 90-100% explained. required_bands [2, 3] are the rulings under 列次 and under 任官ノ年月日: the left leaves of 40 (主計監) and 650 score 6/8 with 100% explained and both missing - the 各部 layout, which prints neither 列次 nor 出身期別. Also rejected: 20 left and 150 right leaves (misdetected), 850 and 875 (index-like, at most 50% explained). The narrow pages score 6/8 here and these pages 6/8 on the narrow template: the two lowest rulings sit 0.018 and 0.013 apart, beyond the 0.01 tolerance, so min_bands_matched 7 keeps each page on its own template. No Shōwa leaf matches more than 5 of 8 or is more than 50% explained; no 1923 leaf passes.

columns.note: Nominal count only, never a gate: 中将 pages carry 5 per leaf, 佐官 pages 8. Officer index 0 is the rightmost strip.

fields.name: service_in_rank
fields.note: 現官ノ實役停年 (legend) - elapsed service in the current rank as 年、月、日, e.g. 三、五、一六 on frame 100 (歩兵少佐). NOT a date: do not parse with reading/eradate.py. Printed once and dittoed 同 along the officers who share it.

fields.name: seniority_no
fields.note: 列次 (legend) - Arabic numerals ascending right-to-left within a section (frame 100: 104-112 right leaf, 113-124 left, with gaps). Numbered within rank: 引田乾作 is 14 among 中将 here, 44 in 大正12年調.

fields.name: appointment_dates
fields.note: 任官ノ年月日 (legend) - ONE cell holding every appointment, each date tagged with the rank it conferred (明治三九、六、二六少尉 / 同四二、一二、一中尉 / 大正…大尉 / 同…少佐), the era dittoed 同. The schema's commissioning_date is the line tagged 少尉 inside it. Not a single date: do not parse the cell with eradate; deliberately not mapped to commissioning_date.

fields.name: cohort
fields.note: 出身期別 (legend) - class of origin, an Arabic number: 16-19 among 歩兵少佐 on frame 100, 5-7 among 中将 on frame 20. The narrow pages also print forms such as 5少; see that template. Presumably the 陸軍士官学校 期 as on the Shōwa pages, but the legend does not say so. No observation column.

fields.name: post
fields.note: 職名、命課ノ年月日 (legend) - the assignment, with the date of the posting in small type at the foot of the cell (第十二師團參謀 / 一四、一二、二).

fields.name: court_rank_decorations
fields.note: 本邦位、勳、功、爵、學位 / 外國勳章 (legend) - e.g. 正六、瑞五、旭四. No observation column.

fields.name: name_raw
fields.note: 氏名 (legend) in large type, with 年齡 in small type beneath: AGE as 年、月 at the 調 date, NOT a birth date as on the Shōwa pages. 引田乾作 reads 五四、一〇 here and 五一、一〇 in 大正12年調. reading/binning.py sets a birth date aside only when it carries an era mark, so these figures stay in the name proposal; the reader separates them.
